communication_goal: 说明发布时间与预期影响，并确认通知渠道。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers coordinate a planned release at a desk. The developer on the left points toward a large circular wall clock centered high between them, the release partner on the right sits beside an open laptop ready to draft a notice. The wall clock must be fully visible, separate from heads, with a black circular rim, twelve simple tick marks and two hands, showing approximately two o'clock: long hand upward, short hand upper-right. No numerals, no letters, no text or speech balloons. Keep clear white space above the clock and below the desk for labels.

image_review.summary: 通过：完整圆形墙钟具十二个刻度、长针朝上与短针朝右上，示意两点；两名同事核对发布安排。clock框选整只墙钟，通知及部署尚为计划，不能声称静态画面证明已发送或已部署。顶部标签已留出钟面上方间距。
